location_exception_reason: Swimming pool tensile covers are custom-fabricated structures quoted per square foot of covered area; location is a project site attribute, not a product differentiator. Buyers search by structural type, fabric material, and frame specification, not by geographic origin.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Fabricator, Contractor) describe the seller's role in the supply-and-install chain, not the product itself. Removing 'Fabricator' or 'Contractor' from a title leaves the product meaning intact; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this distinction to buyers.
